component.name: OBS Puppeteer
component.summary: Unofficial native control panel for OBS Studio

description.p: A native desktop control panel for OBS Studio, talking directly to obs-websocket (bundled with OBS 28 and later). No OBS plugin is needed.

ul.li: Scene list with live preview thumbnails and one-click switching
The current scene's sources, with visibility toggles
Audio mixer with mute toggles, volume faders and live level meters
Stream and record start/stop, with status and timecode
Studio Mode: preview and program scenes, transition picker and transition button
FPS, CPU, bitrate and skipped frames at a glance

description.p: This is an unofficial, third-party tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the OBS Project.
